question: Can an actual first public outcome identify a non-repeated eligible second charge on the three-edge path, and is a non-repeated second charge informative after the complete six-variable-site loop first measurement?
role: Two independent exact ideal-state local diagnostics; not a noisy D4 feedback kernel or full second public round
source_basis: Jing Appendix A.2/A.4 ordered flux-free charge projectors and red-X action
J6L/J6M fixed periodic L=2 graph and common vacuum orbit
J6X exact first law and its censored unconditional second-site gate

common.geometry_state: Pinned J6L periodic L=2 and J6M anyon-free orbit; physical red-X error is private; ideal charge projectors only
common.public_timing: Apply physical error; measure all eligible first stars (deterministic + stars verified); choose a local second star only after the actual first public bits; apply first red-X action before second charge; optional second red-X action before one new third charge on path
common.selection_boundary: Site lookup is preregistered from the exact model and indexed only by measured first bits; runtime choices never inspect private hidden error or an unmeasured outcome. Site IDs and operator masks are retained as private diagnostic metadata.
common.independent_unit: One fixed exact vacuum orbit and geometry per branch with rational counterfactual Born masses; no stochastic unit or Monte Carlo uncertainty

loop.first_rule: Measure every eligible initial star; require six variable sites and every other eligible site deterministic +1; enumerate positive complete first records
loop.second_rule: For each positive first public record, choose the lowest-ID eligible second site whose action-conjugated operator is not equal to any of the six first operators; do not filter on its resulting probability. If none, censor that prefix.
loop.analysis: Exact normalized local second law, record site selection and compare across first prefixes only within the same selected site. No full second-round claim.

three_edge_path.first_rule: Measure all eligible initial stars; require at most two variable sites and deterministic +1 otherwise
three_edge_path.second_rule: For each positive first public record, compute exact conditional one-site charge probabilities for every eligible second star; choose the lowest-ID conditionally variable site whose operator differs from every first measured variable operator. If none, censor that prefix. This replaces J6X's invalid unconditional-variance filter; no two-site requirement.
three_edge_path.third_rule: For each action, choose lowest-ID site newly eligible relative to second sector; require its operator differs from first and selected second operators, else censor that action/prefix. Compare third laws at fixed selected second site and bit, and record whether multiple first prefixes are comparable.

acceptance: All five source pins, incidence, actual-sector eligibility and commutation pass
Every positive first record and retained second/third conditional law is nonnegative and normalized exactly
Prefix-conditioned selection uses public first bits only and each selected operator passes the registered nonrepeat test
Each censored prefix/action is reported; no replacement site or post-hoc action
No stochastic histories, schedule arms, bootstrap, five-round caller change, decoder comparison or threshold claim
stop_rule: Run the path and loop independently under one CPU cap. Fail closed on pin/incidence/commutation or probability-normalization drift. If cap hits, mark only unfinished branch censored and do not enlarge or reinterpret it.
